final: WITH per_rating AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate) / NULLIF(AVG(rental_duration), 0) AS per_day FROM film GROUP BY rating), across_ratings AS (SELECT AVG(per_day) AS average_per_day FROM per_rating) SELECT AVG(p.per_day) AS average_per_day_above, AVG(p.per_day - a.average_per_day) AS average_excess FROM per_rating AS p CROSS JOIN across_ratings AS a WHERE p.per_day > a.average_per_day
